contextThreshold.label: Context Threshold
contextThreshold.help: Fraction of context window that triggers compaction (0.0–1.0)

incrementalMaxDepth.label: Incremental Max Depth
incrementalMaxDepth.help: How deep incremental compaction goes (0 = leaf only, -1 = unlimited)

freshTailCount.label: Fresh Tail Count
freshTailCount.help: Number of recent messages protected from compaction

dbPath.label: Database Path
dbPath.help: Path to the Elytrasless SQLite database

ignoreSessionPatterns.label: Ignored Sessions
ignoreSessionPatterns.help: Glob patterns for session keys to exclude from persistence

statelessSessionPatterns.label: Stateless Sessions
statelessSessionPatterns.help: Glob patterns for session keys that can read memory but never write to it

skipStatelessSessions.label: Skip Stateless Sessions
skipStatelessSessions.help: When enabled, matching stateless session keys skip persistence

summaryProvider.label: Summary Provider
summaryProvider.help: Provider override used when summaryModel is a bare model name

expansionModel.label: Expansion Model
expansionModel.help: Model override for the expansion sub-agent

expansionProvider.label: Expansion Provider
expansionProvider.help: Provider override for the expansion sub-agent

storePath.label: Elytras Store Path
storePath.help: Path to the Elytras control-tower store JSON used to resolve users, teams, and agent bindings.

dataRoot.label: Elytras Data Root
dataRoot.help: Root directory for Elytras-managed tenant data such as users/<id>/USER.md and teams/<id>/TEAM.md.

injectUserContext.label: Inject User Context
injectUserContext.help: Inject USER.md content for the resolved Elytras user into the runtime system prompt.

injectTeamContext.label: Inject Team Context
injectTeamContext.help: Inject TEAM.md content for the resolved Elytras team into the runtime system prompt.

auditLogPath.label: Audit Log Path
auditLogPath.help: JSONL log written by elytrasless after each turn to trace resolved scope and session activity.

maxInjectedChars.label: Max Injected Chars
maxInjectedChars.help: Maximum characters loaded from each Elytras tenant markdown file before truncation.
